result.topic_en: A numerical eclipse example: correcting the mean longitude of the lunar node and the orbital inclination, computing the solar and lunar apparent diameters, parallaxes and hourly motions, and then deriving the argument x from the observed eclipse duration, which differs from the tabular value by 3'23''.
result.transcription:
380 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA.
Pro hoc tempore ex tabulis meis colligitur
longitudo nodi media . . . . . . . . $9^s 8^0 45' 38''$
cujus correctiones sunt Long. ☊ Inclin.
anom. media lunae . . . . $-\ 1'\ 12''$
anom. media solis . . . . . $-\ 1\ 19$
distantia ☊ a ☉. . . . . . . . $-\ 31\ 52$ $5^0 16' 35''$
dist. ☉ a ☽. . . . . . . . $0\ 0$ $-42$
dist. ☊ a ☽. . . . . . . . $-\ 2\ 23$ $+36$
$-\ 36'\ 46''$ $\varrho = 5^0 16' 29''$
et longit. ☊ vera $= 9^s\ 8^0 8' 52''$
longit. umbrae $= 8\ 28\ 5\ 41$ $\frac{1}{2}\varrho = 2^0 38' 15''$
hinc erit $x = -10\ 3\ 11$.
§ 8. Jam est porro $V = 11^s 19^0 38' 30''$ $\cos V = +\cos 10^0 21' 30''$
$v = 4\ 12\ 54\ 33$ $\cos v = -\cos 47\ 5\ 27$
$2v = 8\ 25\ 49\ 6$ $\cos 2v = -\cos 85\ 49\ 6$
$v - V = 4\ 23\ 16\ 3$ $\cos(v - V) = -\cos 36\ 43\ 57$
Unde invenitur: diameter solis apparens $= 31' 41''$
parallaxis solis horizontalis $= 12$
motus horarius solis $= 2\ 23 = m = 143''$
diameter lunae apparens $= 32\ 55$
parallaxis lunae horizontalis $= 59\ 38$
motus lunae horarius $= 36\ 35 = n = 2195$
Ex his fiet: semidiameter umbrae $\alpha = 44\ 0 - \frac{1}{2}$
semidiam. lunae apparens $\beta = 16\ 27 + \frac{1}{2}$
ergo $\alpha + \beta = 60\ 27 = f$
duratio porro eclipsis est $h = 1{,}4389$ horas
atque ob $a = \frac{1}{2}h(n+k)$ fiet $a = 1585'' = 26' 25'$
et $b = \frac{1}{2}h(m+k)$, $b = 109 = 1\ 49$.
§ 9. Cum jam sit $n - m = 2052$ et $m + n + 2k = 2354$ atque $2x = -20^0 6' 22''$, $\frac{1}{2}\varrho = 2^0 38' 15''$, reperietur particula illa $c = -2' 53''$. Deinde, quia habemus
$a + b = 28' 14''$, $a - b = 24' 36''$, $a - b + c = 21' 43''$ et $a - b - c = 27' 29''$
reperietur $-\tang(2x - c) = \frac{120}{39776 \tang(a+b)}$, unde colligitur
$-(2x - c) = 20^0 10' 14'' = -2x + c = -2x - 2' 53''$
ideoque $2x = -20^0 13' 7''$ et $x = -10^0 6' 34''$. Erat autem per tabulas
$x = -10\ 3\ 11$
diff. $3\ 23$
